title: Consider pre-fetching lesson progress on page load
body: handleStart now fetches progress asynchronously when clicked. Consider pre-fetching progress when the ExercisesPager mounts so the resume position is immediately available without waiting for the fetch.
rationale: Current implementation may cause brief flash of wrong exercise before correct one loads

title: Handle edge case: exercises completed out of order
body: The calculateResumeExerciseIndex formula derives position from completionPercentage, which only tracks how many exercises were completed (not which specific ones). If a user skips exercises, the resume position may be incorrect.
rationale: The fix works for normal sequential completion but could be wrong if exercises were skipped
